oliver: Heads-up: Halcyon Labs (HLC-907) flagged for collections. INV-2026-601 due 2026-04-25 unpaid $36,810. Customer claims an accidental sandbox run generated ~$6.2k of usage and wants that credited.
maya: Any chargebacks before?
zane: No prior disputes. billing-bot: Last payment 2026-02-20. Charge attempt 2026-04-26 failed: card declined. Auto-anomaly detected 2026-04-24 (spike +90%).
maya: Sales asks to avoid suspension of core service. Suggest accept partial payment plan: 30% now, remainder in 45 days, provisionally credit up to verified amount.
legal: We can accept conditional plan; include clause that payments don't waive collection rights and credits are subject to telemetry reconciliation. Require written acceptance.
oliver: Ops will reconcile telemetry vs their provided traces. If mismatch, deny credit. If match, cap credit at verified spike ($6.2k).
maya: Draft to customer: "Hi Halcyon 1: we received your dispute. To avoid interruption while we investigate, please pay 30% now ($11,043) via this secure link and provide run IDs for the spike. We will provisionally apply a credit up to $6,200 pending telemetry review (final decision in 7 business days). Remaining balance may be split over 45 days upon receipt of signed payment plan. If no response in 5 business days, we will escalate." Approve to send?
zane: Approve. Add automated reminders day 3 and day 5.
legal: Approve language; change "provisionally apply" to "provisionally apply a credit up to verified amount" and add "this does not constitute a waiver of our rights".
oliver: Sending now to ap@halcyonlabs.ai at 2026-04-27 10:18 UTC  Subject: INV-2026-601 payment & telemetry reconciliation. Billing reattempt scheduled 2026-05-03.
maya: CX on standby for replies.
